Fill in the preschool or daycare name in both places and add your email in B11. Once mdoc restores your phone number, put it in the matching slot in both B10 and B30. Use C for cell, W for work, or H for home.

Leave the child’s name in B08 and all of B13–B29 blank for your sister. Leave B01–B07 blank for the preschool or daycare staff.
